page.overview:
What is Strumia?

Strumia is a country near Tongari Island that was under strife when its princes, Taylor and Lance attempted to save it.

Strumia's only named citizens are its two princes: Taylor, the older brother; and Lance, the younger brother.

Strumia was under some kind of strife when Taylor and Lance left for Tongari Island, hoping to complete the ordeal of the island's Fountain of Miracles to save their land. When they arrived, they realized that Eric accidentally gave the rainbow-colored honey needed to begin the ordeal to Nami, and they paired up with her and Sabo to complete the trial and return the voices of the Straw Hat Pirates.
